[[File:DepotSec.png|thumb|250px|DepotSec troops]]
'''DepotSec''' was a derogatory nickname given to security [[Soldier/Legends|troops]] assigned to guard unimportant supply depots. These troops were considered to be mediocre personnel sent to out-of-the-way duty stations. DepotSec troops were equipped with a [[Blast helmet/Legends|blast helmet]] and an [[Imperial Munitions/Legends|Imperial Munitions]] [[Type D heavy blaster pistol]].<ref name="M">{{WEGCite|story=Meltdown (adventure)|book=Instant Adventures}}</ref>
